title: Quality Studio performance
summary: Tracks measured startup, repository switching, tree transport, review-run latency, rendering, and long-session memory. QS-82 implements the lazy tree transport slice and integrates QS-78 snapshot restoration without duplicating QS-54 cache work; re-measured on 2026-08-24 against origin/main e31089c and independently reproduced on the committed tree b36bfe3 the same day. Reconciled on 2026-08-28 with QS-86, then replayed and fully re-gated on 2026-09-01 against origin/main 7d3abdf; the build, portable tests, security and dependency checks, Angular build/tests, and 13-point tree-v2 contract are green.
